text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Triple Tiara! 
Unbelievable! A massive victory, 
triumphing over both Fusaichi Pandora and 
Kawakami Princess...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—However! Everyone aimed for the queen's 
throne, and no one was willing to yield 
their brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Great job out there, Kawakami! No really, 
that was super touching!!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Pandora! Pandora! I'll come to your next 
race, too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The final leg of the Triple Tiara! 
Unbelievable! A massive victory, 
conquering both Fusaichi Pandora and 
Kawakami Princess...!!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"However! —Every one of them aimed for the 
queen's throne, and none would yield their 
brilliance!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eep, has it been since the Oka Sho? You 
startled me~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yeah, I was running on no sleep 
back then, but even without that, pushing 
past your limit will totally make you 
collapse, huh. Ahaha.

“—Yes, Fusaichi Pandora had lost 
consciousness immediately after the race.”

The examination showed no abnormalities in 
mind or body, concluding simply that she 
had completely exhausted all her strength, 
and yet—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't look so serious! The doctor 
said it was just fatigue, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, could it be you're also feeling 
down about losing?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm bummed. I'm like, seriously 
down in the dumps. *sigh*!

"...The effort she put in over these past 
few months was tremendous. The more I 
think about it, the more the frustration 
builds."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, but still. Didn't this happen even 
after you did everything you could?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
In a way, I got no regrets, y'know? ...We 
did real, reeeaaal good!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...Seriously, that training was brutal. 
Pretty sure I just ran like 100 laps 
around the Earth.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Like, the race was... just too frantic. I 
have no memory of anything past the 3rd 
corner.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I really gave it my all. I really left 
everything out there.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (And yet)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Triple Tiara! 
Unbelievable! A massive victory, 
triumphing over both Fusaichi Pandora and 
Kawakami Princess...!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "...Aaaah! —Ice cream!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ice cream, ice creamâhm? Ugh, there's an 
article about the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That was fast. ...Huh? Wait, this is about 
me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Fusaichi Pandora suffered a narrow defeat 
in the Shuka Sho. However, she showed 
immense potential—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"If she hones her abilities and builds up 
her core strength from here on, we can 
expect thrilling battles where she 
competes on par with the older 
generation."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"She's still just getting started, aiming 
even higher! We have high hopes for 
Fusaichi Pandora's growth!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ..."Above."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Up. By 'up', you mean...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
C-Can I really... go any further than 
this?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I pushed past my limits and 
collapsed, even though I trained like 
crazy, seriously—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, I lost. I wasn't even close. Our 
rivals in the Senior year will be even 
stronger. Realistically speaking, reaching 
that scenery among them is...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (No way... right?)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Pandora! Pandora! Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ! Ah, huh? Ehe? Ehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehehe, ehehehe~! Chuwa-chuwa-chuwa~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Pandora! Pandora! Pan××! ××××!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Huh? Huh-huh-huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "...Haa, haa... ..., that just now—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... that dream... Was I... not in 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ... Ha, haha.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ah-ah.

Having finished the Shuka Sho, she came to 
the Trainer's Room for a meeting to decide 
on our next target race. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! Can I just quit the race now? Pretty 
please♡"

Caught completely off guard by this sudden 
news, I shot to my feet. Sure, she lost, 
but... she certainly didn't seem like she 
was about to quit.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You're worrying way too much ♡ I mean, I 
can pretty much do anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm great at studying, good at sports, 
handy with my hands, and cute, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, I can do pretty much anything, so... 
does it really have to be racing?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, like, real talk? I'm kinda, like, 
tired of racing, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you try, it amounts to 
nothing, right? Maybe racing is the one 
thing you just ain't got the talent for?

My tone grew unintentionally forceful. 
Fusaichi Pandora had grown, changed, and 
kept striving relentlessly for her dream.

Why would she dismiss her own past so 
easily, after fighting so hard to get this 
far?
choice_data_list: Stop putting yourself down like that.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Aha, but isn't that just how it is? No 
matter how much you try, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Training like demons day after day, racing 
with everything we have until we drop, and 
even then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Forget reaching that kind of sight, we 
straight up lost!

...Suddenly, I notice. Fusaichi Pandora's 
voice was trembling.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What is this... what is all this? Even 
after working this hard. Even though the 
Senior year is already starting.

"The Shuka Sho was unfortunate. But if she 
doesn't give up and keeps pushing forward 
with this effort, surely—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I told you, that's not enough!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted something way more amazing! It 
was supposed to be way cooler than this!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Way, way more—the greatest and most 
awesome in history, with everyone cheering 
wildly, right at the center of the world, 
a miracle, completely one-of-a-kind—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That was my dream!!
—I find myself at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, the truth is! I've known it 
since the Oaks, it's totally different 
from my dream!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Someone like me... ngh, would peak out 
before even making it come true!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"What am I supposed to do? I'm a 
genius—that's why I've been chasing this 
dream."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, she's just a totally normal 
Umamusume after all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's why I don't want to run anymore!
I chase after her as she dashes out.

Overcome with deep regret, realizing that 
I hadn't understood the dream she 
envisioned at all.

—Fusaichi Pandora was in a corner of the 
school building.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Don't come following me.

"Still, I have to deny it no matter what. 
Fusaichi Pandora is—"
choice_data_list: You are the greatest genius in this world.
You're the greatest genius in this world.

text_block_list.text:
From the very first time I saw her run, I 
sensed a clear difference in talent 
compared to other Umamusume.

The more properly she trained, the sharper 
her innate talent truly became.
choice_data_list: I've truly meant that all along.

text_block_list.text:
"If anything, had that not been the case, 
I never would have been able to keep 
supporting them this far."
choice_data_list: So... please don't give up just yet.

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the ideal I envisioned was a dream 
far grander than I could have imagined, 
but still.
choice_data_list: I'm not giving up yet, either.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh* ...Dummy Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, you're practically a doting parent 
at this point. I mean, what's up with 
that—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Papa, Mama... Do you really think I can 
win?

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text: Of course! We can definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I got a LANE message from 
Kuu-chan-senpai! ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Great job. Keep giving it your all from 
now on. I'm rooting for you!" "I'll keep 
working hard too!"—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't that kinda unfair?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, like, like, you know... ...I just 
can't quit after all that, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little bit longer, okay?

After that, I managed to get her to stay 
and talked to her about the next race for 
the time being.

"A supreme GⅠ race where victory brings 
brilliance and brings you closer to your 
grand dream: the Queen Elizabeth II Cup."

With that set as the next goal, Fusaichi 
Pandora was on board as well.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh* Seriously, I'm so exhausted 
today.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...I mean, getting soft on Trainer? 
That's hilarious, honestly.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I said I'd keep going, but... really, 
though...?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...No way. There's no way I can make my 
dream come true.)

—The next goal was the 'Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup'. I wanted to run alongside her with 
everything we had.
